verdict.rationale: OpenHands' own documented automations produce AI-generated insights and suggestions from a user's engineering data. They suggest incident severity from logs and recent changes, identify likely causes of failed workflows and propose fixes, and post AI review comments on PRs. This is limited to code, logs and PR context through agent tasks, not a general in-product data-insights experience. Missing for 10: insights over arbitrary user data beyond code, logs and PRs; a dedicated in-product insights or suggestions surface; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: gather logs and recent changes, suggest severity, and route the issue to the right owner
Detect failed workflows, inspect logs, identify the likely cause, and open a pull request with a proposed fix.
inspect full PR context, and post an AI review comment once per label event
Review security alerts, validate the finding, update affected code
